lines.zh: 我慢慢地爬，四肢贴着地。
lines.en: I crawl slowly, limbs flat to the ground.

lines.zh: 每挪一步，都有一下轻响。
lines.en: Each shift makes a soft sound.

lines.zh: 我从树后换到另一棵树后。
lines.en: I move from behind one tree to behind another.

lines.zh: 我的身体太长了，折不起来。
lines.en: My body is too long to fold up.
You can hear each crawl of mine.
For every step you take, I creep half a block.
I'm in no hurry. I'm slower than you.
But I never stop crawling.
The grass shows my track.

lines.zh: 我上墙了，你回头也看不见。
lines.en: I'm on the wall. Look back and you won't see it.

lines.zh: 我从低处来，你总是往上看。
lines.en: I come from low down. You always look up.
I'm three or four steps behind you.
I stop, limbs braced on the ground.

lines.zh: 我这样趴着，很难认出来。
lines.en: Lying like this, I'm hard to make out.

lines.zh: 窗缝里的风，带着你的汗味。
lines.en: The draft through the window carries your sweat.

lines.zh: 我在听，你的脚步有没有变。
lines.en: I'm listening for a change in your steps.

lines.zh: 我缩在柜子后面，数你的脚步。
lines.en: I huddle behind the cabinet, counting your steps.

lines.zh: 我的骨头会响，我尽量不动。
lines.en: My bones click. I try to stay still.
I've been in this wood before.

lines.zh: 我等了很久，也不在乎再等。
lines.en: I've waited long. Waiting more is nothing.
When you go further, I follow.

lines.zh: 我爬得很慢，脚步声却很重。
lines.en: I crawl slowly, and my steps are heavy.
Every step of yours, I count.
Another short stretch to go.

lines.zh: 等近到能听见我，就晚了。
lines.en: When you can hear me, it's too late.

lines.zh: 我在梁上倒挂着，等你经过。
lines.en: I hang upside down from the beam, waiting.

lines.zh: 你在看我，可你看不出我。
lines.en: You're looking at me, but you can't make me out.

lines.zh: 我站在树影里，就跟你一样高。
lines.en: In the tree's shadow I'm as tall as you.

lines.zh: 那声咔哒，是我在试关节。
lines.en: That click was me testing my joints.
That sound wasn't me.

lines.zh: 你回头时，我只剩一道影子。
lines.en: When you turn, I am only a shadow.
But I wasn't there.
I'm not there. I'm over here.

lines.zh: 你站得那么直，脖子很显眼。
lines.en: You stand so straight. Your neck is obvious.
I shift slowly toward you.
Two more steps for you.
I've been moving. Only slightly.
Your torch doesn't reach far enough.
I'm in this patch of dark.
I lie behind the door, breathing softly.
This is what I wait for.

lines.zh: 你听见那一声脆响了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear that click.
That was my doing.
Now run. I've started.

lines.zh: 你跑过的草地，我都记得。
lines.en: I remember every patch of grass you cross.

lines.zh: 我的指尖已经碰到你的影子。
lines.en: My fingertips already touch your shadow.
I lurch and push myself back up.
My shoulder bone is askew; I crawl on.
I don't hurt. I stopped hurting long ago.
You broke one of my steps.
I drop flat to the ground.

lines.zh: 关节响了一串，我慢慢收拢。
lines.en: A chain of joints clicks. I gather myself.
My hand is still reaching forward.

lines.zh: 你砍中我，我退半步又停。
lines.en: You cut me; I retreat half a step and stop.
That changes nothing.
After this, I'll come again.
You're setting that on the ground.
Sniffed. Not to my taste.
All four limbs to the ground, I crawl slowly.
You bent down.
That works nicely.

lines.zh: 你把背转过来，正合我意。
lines.en: You turn your back—just what I wanted.
Lower still. Don't look up.
Don't pick up what you dropped.

lines.zh: 你不该背对我，我正在慢慢爬近。
lines.en: You should not turn your back; I am crawling closer.
The lamp in your hand cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，可你没察觉。
lines.en: You touched me and didn't notice.
I press against you and slide away.

lines.zh: 我太高了，肩膀露在外面。
lines.en: I'm too tall. My shoulder sticks out.
You stepped back into me.
You backed into me and didn't turn.
I'm behind you. Very close.
You raised a hand and touched my leg.
For that instant, I froze.
You froze too.
Then I drew back.
I don't have that.
You and I won't become anything.

lines.zh: 我不需要伴，只需要你跑。
lines.en: I need no mate—only for you to run.
Until you stop running.
That counts as together.
You walk the night road. I'm behind.

lines.zh: 我爬得很慢，脚步声很重。
lines.en: I crawl slow, and my steps are heavy.
I've always been here. I never left.
Like this until dawn.
Or perhaps not until dawn.
I brace on one hand.
The other reaches out.
It's too far from me.
I drag myself an inch.

lines.zh: 潜行时带着重物会出声。
lines.en: Carrying weight breaks my stealth.
I only want to watch you bend.

lines.zh: 你捡东西的时候，最没有防备。
lines.en: When you pick things up, you're unguarded.
I stay still until you straighten.
That's only fair.
Get up. Walk on.
You've walked into my ground.

lines.zh: 我从地板缝里，慢慢抬头。
lines.en: I raise my head slowly from the floor crack.
My limbs push me up.
This step I take very lightly.
You're still walking. Good.
Two more steps and I'm there.

lines.zh: 你屏住呼吸，我却听见心跳。
lines.en: You hold your breath, but I hear your heart.
You haven't heard me yet.
You stopping here suits me.
I set a hand on the ground.
Did you hear that.
Did you hear it? Click.
After that sound, run.
Run. Start running.
Run. I'll watch.
I'm starting now.
You slow down, and so do I.
You run, and I speed up.
You climb a wall. So do I.
You duck into a hole. I crawl in.

lines.zh: 你翻过栅栏，我贴着地钻过去。
lines.en: You vault a fence. I slide under.
I follow. I don't stop.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我还在那个距离。
lines.en: Look back. I'm at the same distance.
Not far. Not near.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我保持了整夜。
lines.en: I've held it all night.
I crawl close with heavy steps.
The more you slow, the less I will.
I crawl slowly, but these footsteps are heavy.

lines.zh: 我看见你扶了一下膝盖。
lines.en: I saw you brace a knee.
How much road have you left.
You head for the stairs; I take the short way.
That's a dead end.
You get there first. I follow.
Then I block the doorway.
You'll have to turn.
And I'll be there.

lines.zh: 我的掌心贴住你的后颈。
lines.en: My palm presses against your nape.
Light, but you can't lift it.
My other hand comes around.
You struggle once. It does nothing.
I'm thin, and heavy.
I press down with all of me.

lines.zh: 骨头相碰的声音，你听见了。
lines.en: You heard bone meet bone.
I crawl low, and I am loud.
I only need to follow you.
Always following. To the end.
Your breathing has gone shallow.
My hand isn't squeezing.
You're sinking on your own.
Stop struggling. You can't get free.
Soon it will be quiet.
I've waited for this.
My footsteps come first.
Heavy. Slow.
Only then do you see the outline.

lines.zh: 我四肢着地，站起来很高。
lines.en: On all fours I rise very tall.

lines.zh: 我的身体太长，像被拉过。
lines.en: My body is too long, as if stretched.

lines.zh: 风穿过我，我没什么可挡的。
lines.en: The wind goes through me. Nothing to block it.

lines.zh: 这片林子里，只有你和我。
lines.en: In this wood there's only you and me.
I crawled here from far away.
I don't know why.
I only know I must get close.

lines.zh: 我的身体太长，像被拉过一样。
lines.en: My body is too long, as if stretched.
I'll stand here for now.
I'll stand. Until you walk.
When you're far, I'll follow.
Then I follow.
It's always been this way.
The wood creaked—it was not the wind.
That movement. It's me shifting.

lines.zh: 地板的响声，一格一格靠近。
lines.en: The floorboards creak closer, board by board.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很重，可你看不见我。
lines.en: My steps are heavy, yet you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 火照着我的轮廓，我不躲。
lines.en: Fire lights my outline. I don't dodge.

lines.zh: 我从墙上掉下来，摔成一堆。
lines.en: I fell off the wall and landed in a heap.

lines.zh: 水没过头顶，我在下面走。
lines.en: Water's over my head. I walk beneath it.
The blast knocked my limbs apart.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过我，钉在树上。
lines.en: Something went through me into a tree.

lines.zh: 那光让我显了形，很难看。
lines.en: That light showed my shape. It's ugly.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，也不觉得缺。
lines.en: I don't eat, and I don't feel the lack.

lines.zh: 雷光劈落，我四肢猛地一缩。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; my limbs jerk inward.
There's no ground here to crawl on.
